signupBonus.headline: Rakeback-based rewards across a 25-tier VIP ladder (Beginner through Immortal) rather than a fixed deposit-match bonus
signupBonus.detail: Roobet's main ongoing reward is continuous rakeback paid instantly, daily, weekly and monthly depending on tier, scaling with wagered volume rather than deposit size. We could not confirm a single flat welcome-bonus percentage that applies to every new signup; check the offer attached to your own registration link.

editorial.summary:
Roobet is one of the longer-running crypto casinos on this site, live since 2019 under a Curacao licence (OGL/2024/687/0427). It runs a large catalogue — 6,000+ slots, 500+ live tables, a sportsbook and esports markets — and in May 2026 became one of the first major crypto casinos to launch an integrated prediction-markets product alongside the usual games, a genuine and fairly recent differentiator rather than a marketing rebrand of something everyone already has.

Compared with several other casinos on this site, Roobet's problems read as more ordinary. There is no bankruptcy ruling, no confirmed data breach and no criminal investigation attached to it as of this check. AskGamblers records a real but comparatively modest complaint pattern: an average disputed withdrawal around $11,669 taking about 9 days to resolve, with the platform describing complaint volume as low relative to a reported 118,000 monthly players. Most of that appears tied to routine KYC checks on larger cashouts rather than anything more unusual.

Two specific mechanics are worth knowing before you sign up. First, KYC is mandatory before any withdrawal — not the conditional, threshold-based pattern several other casinos here use — and verification on withdrawals above roughly $1,000 to $2,000 commonly moves into a manual review that can take hours to days, while smaller cashouts are usually fast. Second, Roobet blocks over 50 countries including the US, UK, Australia and Canada's Ontario, and its terms prohibit VPN use to get around that. The part worth flagging specifically: community reports consistently describe restricted-region accounts getting locked at the withdrawal stage rather than at registration or deposit, meaning a player can build a real balance before discovering the account is unusable — a materially worse outcome than being blocked up front.

Roobet's Trustpilot profile currently carries the same guideline-breach suspension notice we've now seen on more than one casino in this space, following removal of manipulated reviews; we are not displaying a Trustpilot figure as a result, consistent with how we handle that situation elsewhere on this site.
